thesis: The page is the studio's sterilization log, open on the counter: every section is a logged entry, and the indicator tape seals each one, its stripes darkening as you read it, so the visitor watches the shop pass its own check.

signature.name: Indicator Tape
signature.summary: A skewed strip of autoclave indicator tape (cream with 45-degree stripes) whose stripes darken from pre-cycle tan to cycled umber-black as --sw-p goes 0 to 1. It seals the hero session sheet, crosses every section break, runs under the autoclave cycle gauge one fifth per step, corners the logged review entries and price ledger, tags the ear-map piercing, and closes the footer fully dark (LOG CLOSED).

palette.family: Autoclave Graphite + Tape Cream + Indicator Rose

layoutMoves: Log-book grid: a 2-col mono margin column (entry No., time, cycle) runs down the left of every section on desktop
Ledger rows instead of cards for services and prices (full-width ruled rows, mono figures right-aligned)
Pinned autoclave cycle story with an SVG dial gauge, then a cream ear-map tool band breaking the dark run

motion.intro: Session sheet lines type in with a clip wipe (60ms stagger), hero tape darkens over 900ms, round PASS stamp lands; under 1.1s, any input skips.
stories: Cycle (dial): pinned >=640px, 5 steps LOAD/HEAT/HOLD/DRY/LOG, gauge needle dials, one fifth of the tape darkens per step; stacked clip-reveal cards below 640.
Ledger (count): price rows enter, sample figures count up 400ms, closing tape darkens.
motion.hover: A rose tape tab grows from the left edge of rows, cards and links (scale 0 to 1, 200ms).
